headline: GTA VI delayed again, now set for Nov 19, 2026
summary: Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel faces further delays, with digital preorders now open for its $79.99 standard edition.
details: Grand Theft Auto VI, the successor to the decade-old GTA V, has been pushed back twice, now targeting a November 19th, 2026 release date. This latest delay moves the launch a full year from its originally planned fall 2025 window.
Preorders for the digital-only game are now live, with the standard edition priced at $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition at $99.99. Both editions will be available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

The game will feature dual protagonists, Lucia and Jason, navigating Vice City after a criminal job goes awry. This follows earlier leaks of game builds and recent "CyberLeek" posts showcasing gameplay sequences.

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick described the pre-order levels as "unprecedented and astonishing." An extended preview of GTA VI is scheduled to stream on August 27th, with a Netflix exclusive showing six hours earlier.

Notably, GTA VI will not be released on physical discs. Take-Two's business is already heavily digital, with over 90% of distribution being digital. Physical copies will contain codes for the digital download.
caption:

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick described the pre-order levels as "unprecedented and astonishing." An extended preview of GTA VI is scheduled to stream on August 27th, with a Netflix exclusive showing six hours earlier.

Notably, GTA VI will not be released on physical discs. Take-Two's business is already heavily digital, with over 90% of distribution being digital. Physical copies will contain codes for the digital download.
